sources.claim: Apple: 'iPhone automatically stops charging when the battery is fully charged, so it's safe to keep your iPhone connected to a charger overnight'; avoid using or charging in ambient temperatures higher than 95 F (35 C), which can permanently reduce battery lifespan

Apple: Optimized Battery Charging uses on-device machine learning to learn your daily charging routine; iPhone will delay charging past 80 percent in certain situations; needs at least 14 days to learn your charging habits

post.instagram_caption:
Charging your phone overnight does not ruin the battery.

Apple says an iPhone stops charging on its own when the battery is full, and that it is safe to keep it connected to a charger overnight. Optimized Battery Charging learns your routine (it needs at least 14 days) and can hold the charge at 80% when it expects a long charge.

The real enemy is heat: Apple says using or charging above 35°C (95°F) can permanently reduce battery lifespan.

The lesson: plug it in at night, just keep it somewhere cool.

Source: Apple Support, "Charge and maintain your iPhone battery" and "About Charge Limit and Optimized Battery Charging on iPhone".

The real enemy is heat: Apple says charging above 35°C (95°F) can permanently reduce battery lifespan.
